forms.label: Safe conditional and sequential request
forms.japanese: 安全なら元栓を閉め、火を消してください。どのスイッチにも触らないでください。
forms.english: If it's safe, close the valve and put out the flame; don't touch any switch.
forms.explanation: 安全なら states “if it is safe.” 閉め is the connective stem of 閉める, linking the valve action to 消してください, a polite request. どのスイッチにも pairs with the negative 触らないでください to mean “do not touch any switch.”

forms.label: Negative requests
forms.japanese: たばこを吸わないでください。ライターも使わないでください。
forms.explanation: 吸う→吸わない and 使う→使わない precede でください to form polite negative requests. も after ライター adds “either” to the second prohibition.

forms.label: Conditional danger
forms.japanese: だれかが何かに火をつけたら、危険になります。
forms.english: If anyone lights anything, there will be danger.
forms.explanation: つけたら is the たら conditional of つける, expressing an if-clause, not past time here. だれかが何かに supplies “anyone” and “anything”; 危険になります states the resulting danger.

forms.label: Possible gas leak report
forms.japanese: 屋台広場でガス漏れの可能性があります。
forms.english: There's a possible gas leak at a food truck park.
forms.explanation: ガス漏れの可能性があります reports a possibility, not a confirmed leak. で locates the possible leak at the food-truck park.

forms.label: Location report
forms.japanese: 正面入口の前で、駐車場の隣です。
forms.english: We're in front of the main entrance, next to the parking lot.
forms.explanation: 正面入口の前で and 駐車場の隣です give two location descriptions. The で is the connective form of です joining them, not a locative で particle.

forms.label: Identifying clothing and waiting
forms.japanese: 赤いTシャツを着て、正面入口でお待ちします。
forms.english: I'll wait for you at the main entrance in a red T-shirt.
forms.explanation: 着て is the te-form of 着る, describing the red T-shirt the speaker will be wearing while waiting. お待ちします is the humble form of 待ちます used by the speaker.

forms.label: Arrival, inspection and confirmation
forms.japanese: 10分後、消防隊員が到着し、ホースを調べてガス漏れを確認します。
forms.english: Ten minutes later, the firefighters arrive, check the hose and confirm the leak.
forms.explanation: 到着し and 調べて connect the arrival and hose inspection to 確認します, confirmation of the leak. 10分後 (じゅっぷんご) means ten minutes later.
